page.title_raw: Death - Definitions - Spells - Archives of Nethys: Pathfinder RPG Database

entity_raw.definition_raw: Spells with the death descriptor directly attack a creature's life force to cause immediate death, or to draw on the power of a dead or dying creature. The death ward spell protects against death effects, and some creature types are immune to death effects.
